THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 7 · Twin pools
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Two dark pools fill much of the cavern. Water presses against rough stone-and-timber dams. The waterfall’s echo makes quieter movement hard to place.

The rough barriers hold back a great deal of water, and the noise fills the space around them. You can inspect their visible supports, look for ground that stays out of the current, or study the onward route before putting someone beside a dam.

Ask the players

“Do you approach the guards, examine the dams, or try a different route?”
